context_length: Trained at 512 residues, then 2,048 for the last 500k steps; longer sequences are embedded whole here
summary: The 600M ESM Cambrian encoder: its developers report that it rivals ESM-2 3B and approaches ESM-2 15B, producing 1152-dim embeddings.
architecture: Encoder-only transformer, 36 layers and width 1152, with pre-LayerNorm, rotary embeddings, SwiGLU and no biases. Companion to the generative ESM3.
pretraining_data: UniRef plus metagenomic sequences from MGnify and the Joint Genome Institute, clustered at 70% identity (83M, 372M and 2B clusters).
key_innovations: Reported to rival ESM-2 3B and approach ESM-2 15B at a fraction of the size
Representation-focused companion to ESM3, released as open weights
when_to_use: When you want near-ESM-2-3B quality without the 3B footprint; a strong modern default in the mid-size range (1152-dim).
caveats: Documented in a release note rather than a peer-reviewed paper.
